browserSignInTitle: Sign in to Nimi securely in your browser
browserSignInDescription: Nimi account credentials are entered only on the Web. Your browser returns securely to this device when finished.
loginPending: Complete sign-in in your browser. This window will continue automatically.
reauthenticationRequired: Your Runtime account session can no longer be refreshed. Sign in again to continue.
